title: HTTP invocation recorder UI compatibility result
claim: The existing OpenCode HTTP lifecycle invocation attempt dry-run recorder is callable through the ChatGPT MCP UI and records schema-shaped blocked-before-action artifacts without invoking lifecycle execution.
summary: A controlled UI call to the existing non-executing OpenCode HTTP lifecycle invocation attempt dry-run recorder succeeded for source packet FP-MCP-254 and plan HTTPPLAN-20260703T233517042Z-9242deff. The recorder wrote preflight/result artifacts for attempt HTTPINVOCATION-20260704T003648390Z-f653b8f8. The result remained blocked before action and did not create a session, submit a prompt, invoke lifecycle execution, consume approval, start OpenCode, call wait, delete sessions, or contact the runner start endpoint.
caveats: FP-MCP-261 previously observed platform safety blocking for the same recorder path before reaching the MCP server; this checkpoint supersedes that compatibility observation only for the successful UI call made at attempt HTTPINVOCATION-20260704T003648390Z-f653b8f8.
This checkpoint does not authorize or implement the real single-shot lifecycle invocation gate.
The committed artifacts are schema-shaped dry-run attempt artifacts, not model execution evidence.
boundaries: no OpenCode process start from terminal
